products.product_description: Frozen Pangasius Fish, brand name T&T, in the following sizes: a. IQF 15 lbs bulk carton: 3/5 oz, 5/7 oz, 7/9 oz, 9/11 oz b. 11lbs x 2 per carton: 8/10 oz and 10 oz/up c. 2lbs x 5 per carton: 2/3 oz d. 15lbs carton: 2/3 oz Product labeling reads in part:" T&T SWAI ROSE ROLL(Pangasius hypophtalmus)***FARM-RAISED PRODUCT OF VIETNAM***". Packaged in paper box carton.
